class.name: TamaServerBullet
class.brief_description: Lightweight handle to a single active server bullet, passed through the [signal TamaManager.bullet_hit] signal.

members.member: Current world position of the bullet.
Current travel angle of the bullet in radians.
Current speed of the bullet in pixels per second.
World-space X velocity component added on top of the directional speed (from [code]accel[/code]).
World-space Y velocity component added on top of the directional speed (from [code]accel[/code]).
Whether this bullet is currently active. [code]false[/code] after the bullet has been recycled.
